'''Micah Wooten''' (forum handle '''KeonUlic''') is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player.<ref name="pcf-3961-54071">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54071#54071 Tourney In TN on Sept 18th...All Welcome], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102220746/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54092%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 2nd at the 2005 Tennessee State Championship on 16 July 2005, which had 12 players; because the winner, Danny Pack, had already won the Alabama State Championship, Wooten received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2005 World Championship]] at Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-5728-89177">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=89177#89177 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref>

From 2004 he helped run the monthly Star Wars CCG tournaments in Tennessee. He announced a tournament at the Game Keep in Heritage on 3 July 2004,<ref name="pcf-3536-48344">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48344#48344 Don't Forget Tourney in TN on July 3rd at the Keep!], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041210023939/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48344%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and after he and [[Royce Russell]] attended the [[2004 World Championship]] at Gen Con they resumed the tournaments at Outer Limits in Franklin on 18 September 2004.<ref name="pcf-3961-54071" /> He posted the tournament details on the PC forum and in the DeckTech group "Tennessee Star Wars Fans": the tournaments were held on the third Saturday of every month, the October 2004 one being moved to 23 October at 2pm because of the ''Wars'' release weekend.<ref name="pcf-2860-54919">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54919#54919 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In January 2005 he described them as Nashville tournaments, the next on 19 February 2005.<ref name="pcf-4450-60501">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60501#60501 players], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015133/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60410%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The 23 October 2004 tournament drew 11 players<ref name="pcf-2860-55364">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55364#55364 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and the 19 February 2005 tournament 10.<ref name="pcf-2860-63487">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63487#63487 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In February 2005 Russell wrote that Wooten had taken over running the Tennessee tournaments from him.<ref name="pcf-4461-61602">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61602#61602 Posting your tournaments on the Decipher system?], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050302115920/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60799%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Wooten announced the 2005 Tennessee State Championship, held at Outer Limits in Franklin.<ref name="pcf-5728-80377">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=80377#80377 Tennessee States July 16th....], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> His forum signature in June 2006 named him a "Member of Team Tennessee".<ref name="pcf-10285-141033">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141033#141033 Errata PDF], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618093001/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=140948&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>
